headline: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑今日热搜
headlineEn: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops today's trending
summary: 今日有两部新片上映，本周共六部新片。热门榜首《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑，另有《恶魔之口》《超级少女》等。下周将迎《오케이 마담 2》和《The Last Sunrise》。
summaryEn: Two new movies released today, six this week. Top trending: Spider-Man: Brand New Day, followed by Devil's Mouth, Supergirl, etc. Upcoming: Okay Madam 2 and The Last Sunrise.

industryHighlights.text: 今日两部新片上映，本周共六部新片
industryHighlights.en: Two new movies released today, six this week

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》蝉联本周热度榜首位
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops weekly trending

industryHighlights.text: 《恶魔之口》紧随其后，热度攀升
industryHighlights.en: Devil's Mouth follows closely, gaining popularity

industryHighlights.text: 下周期待韩国电影《오케이 마담 2》与《The Last Sunrise》
